archetypes.name: dyn-bg-wait
archetypes.rationale: Hook and prompt contracts jointly control bg-wait recovery.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the hook change and prompt updates together. Verify Read of tasks/*.output is allowed only through the Read-tool path, while Bash probes, TaskOutput, marker-dir reads, result env reads, and terminal-sentinel polling remain guarded. Check same-clone and foreign-clone behavior against the updated harness expectations. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
